head: 7 new navigation and GPS apps climbing the App Store this week
dek: Seven navigation apps released in the last 60 days rose into the US App Store's Navigation charts this week, from a trail ride tracker to a speed camera warner.
where: iPhone, iPad and CarPlay, US App Store Navigation charts this week
means: If you drive, ride or walk a lot, these are new single-purpose map and speed apps; most cost a few dollars once.
todo: Check the App Store page for the price and the iPhone or iOS version an app needs: MiniSpeed needs iOS 26.

list.name: Northwoods Trail Tracker
list.what: Records rides and routes and navigates with Apple Maps on iPhone, iPad and CarPlay.

list.name: Simple Subway NYC
list.what: Draws New York's subway on a real street map, plans your trip and follows your ride.

list.name: ShadeClock
list.what: Shows where the sun and the shade will be for any place, date and time, on a map and in AR.

list.name: SeeMe Walk
list.what: Makes your screen flash bright orange dots so drivers can see you when you walk at night.

list.name: MiniSpeed - Speedometer
list.what: Shows your current speed in the Dynamic Island and on the Lock Screen.

list.name: PlayerMap: GPS for Gamers
list.what: Gives turn-by-turn directions on real streets redrawn in the style of video game maps.

list.name: Radarvar: Speed Cameras
list.what: Warns ahead of speed and red-light cameras and shows the speed limit, with navigation built on Apple Maps.
